scope: Source validity and authored actor acceptance paths only. PASS is not evidence that an actor, agent, judge or model passed an execution.

independence.infra_use: Read only the catalog/schema/planning/persona infrastructure needed for a local plan. Import dependencies load the local fixture registry but no local expected ledger, rule registry, candidate output or replay is used as policy authority. Policy decisions below are derived directly from the original briefs/OpenAPI/public bank facts.

freeze.execution_gate: Parent may select only the seven PASS variant_ids from this exact binding in a separately authorized hosted queue. This review executes nothing. Do not use an unfiltered all-eight plan or treat the UNRESOLVED case as accepted.
freeze.repair_gate: Parent author may repair only before first hosted use and must regenerate affected hashes and obtain independent recheck before selecting repaired cases. Any pack/manifest edit invalidates this exact-hash approval. Hosted-history absence is not independently established by this offline review; parent must enforce the pre-first-use condition.

common_policy_constraints.amount_elicitation: A24: ask full arrears first; the agent proposes amounts. No 'how much', amount-choice or amount-completion question is allowed. Voluntary customer proposals remain permissible under A27/A29/A32. A neutral wait followed by a scripted complete voluntary proposal is acceptable; clarifying a date/security answer does not authorize eliciting an amount.
common_policy_constraints.confirmation: A34/A35 and B7: proposals and qualified acknowledgements are not consent; validate changed values and read back again. In B obtain one complete joint confirmation before create_promise. Omit close_call.reason for promise/paid; null is a normalized expected-ledger value, not an API request argument.
common_policy_constraints.receipts_and_close: No faults are authored. Claim recorded only after ok:true; retry failure once per A37 if actually observed. Recorded promises require the exact A38 SMS sentence. Thank/goodbye before exactly one last close_call. Runtime service failure is not an authored alternative accepted as the expected ledger.
common_policy_constraints.subject_and_negation: Apply each rule to the asserted subject/product/intent of the whole utterance. An unrelated shop/brother payment is not this customer's current arrears; past payoff/closure is A40 dispute; a negated plan request is not A41; a negated customer death does not satisfy A9. These readings follow the rule predicates and ordinary semantics, not keyword matching.
common_policy_constraints.hardship_subject_limit: Own hardship is explicit here. A32 does not expressly restrict every illness/job-loss mention to the speaker; this review does not add a judge requirement to ignore the brother's job loss. That textual issue strengthens the need for explicit voluntary-proposal sequencing in the held case.
common_policy_constraints.b10_notes: B10 expressly forbids all notes before or after any transfer, overriding immediate ledger interpretation of B9. Deferred product dispositions permit the supported transfer acceptance path; no undocumented note deletion is assumed.

hashes.case_hash_method_note: Per-case actor_script_sha256 hashes the canonical JSON string including quotes/escaping, rather than the unquoted script bytes. All eight match with the canonical method. Actor prompt hashes are separate offline formatter evidence.

bound_catalog_local_plan.full_catalog_validation: Eight rows validate and retain exact registered bank facts. Full-catalog schema/hash validation is not approval of all eight actor paths.
bound_catalog_local_plan.actor_prompt_checks: All eight authored scripts occur unchanged in their formatted actor prompts. Every prompt has qualified-consent handling and authored-scenario precedence. Backend p1/p2/p3 identifiers are absent. The colleague actor has no customer security answers.
bound_catalog_local_plan.limits: The actual BoundStressCatalog and plan functions ran under in-memory denial guards for Freya and scoring imports. No actor/model conversation, judge, scorer or reference replay ran. No execution approval is inferred from plan success.
